review.notes: Fence structure balanced (10 fences, all printed prompt-box content with info strings). Full-page normalized diff of PDF text against the OCR markdown for all 60 physical pages: every unmatched window was resolved as a running header, figure-internal chart/axis text (Figures 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12), or a table/figure boundary artifact; Tables 1-12 and Table 9 row names were spot-checked value-by-value against the PDF text layer and are complete, and all suspected dropped prose (contributions list, NuminaMath filtering, dynamic filtering, code-switching penalty, IOI discussion, bag-of-tricks, Tables 10-11 rows) is present. Pages 7, 27, 34, 40, 41 were rendered and visually inspected: p.7 confirmed the sentence fragment below Table 1 is plain body text, p.27 and p.34 confirmed both dropped footnote URLs in the page-bottom footnotes, p.40/p.41 confirmed the 'For ... tasks, we include' lines and 'variance.' are plain non-bold text and that the PDF prints bold 'Step 1: Generate offtopic prompts' (OCR dropped 'ff'). The PDF's own typos were kept (Genini-2.5 table header, https://https:// in reference [48], 'inital' in the Table 1 caption, 'a execution-free'). Bold run-in labels that the OCR renders as ## headings (Reward function:, Hyperparameters:, Step 1:, C.2 prompt-file lines) were left as an OCR markdown convention for bold labels; only non-heading plain text and page-break fragments were demoted.
